description: Native work requirement and saved progress for the first eligible occupied building slot

extractions.label: building_work
extractions.expression: (() => { const tower=idleon.getAttr("TowerInfo"), defs=idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.TowerInfo; for (let slot=0;slot<8;slot++) { const index=Number(tower[54+slot]); if(index<0) continue; const level=Number(tower[index]), base=Number(defs[index][8]), maxLevel=base+idleon.callFunction("WorkbenchStuff","ExtraMaxLvAtom",base,index), progress=Number(tower[66+index]), required=idleon.callFunction("WorkbenchStuff","TowerBuildReq",index,0); if(level<maxLevel && level===Number(tower[index+27]) && progress<required) return {slot,index,level,progress,required,maxLevel}; } return null; })()
extractions.description: First eligible occupied slot, building level, native maximum, work progress, and next-level work requirement
